```plato

    // True when two normalized cell coordinates denote the same node of the
    // tiled lattice, comparing them folded onto the near faces.
    SameLatticeNode(a: Point3D, b: Point3D): Boolean
        => (WrapCellCoordinate(a.X) - WrapCellCoordinate(b.X)).Abs <= LatticeUnitCell.NodeTolerance
        && (WrapCellCoordinate(a.Y) - WrapCellCoordinate(b.Y)).Abs <= LatticeUnitCell.NodeTolerance
        && (WrapCellCoordinate(a.Z) - WrapCellCoordinate(b.Z)).Abs <= LatticeUnitCell.NodeTolerance;
```
